tables.name: tavern
tables.description: Rumors overheard in a tavern or inn

entries.text: A band of goblins has been raiding caravans on the old trade road.
The old crypt north of town is haunted by restless dead.
A dragon's hoard lies beneath the ruined tower on the hill.
The merchant guild is secretly smuggling cursed artifacts.
Healing herbs grow in abundance near the Forest Shrine.
The blacksmith's son went missing exploring the old mines.
A wandering wizard offers powerful enchantments for a price.
Underground tunnels connect the tavern cellar to the castle.
Wolves in the northern forest are led by a massive dire wolf.
The river troll demands a toll of 10 gold pieces to cross the bridge.
Treasure hunters found a sealed vault beneath the old temple.
The king's tax collector is actually a shapeshifting doppelganger.

tables.name: market
tables.description: Gossip heard while shopping at the market square

entries.text: Bandits ambushed a merchant caravan last week — the road south is dangerous.
A rare gemstone was found in the creek bed near the old mill.
The apothecary sells potions that can cure any disease.
Strange lights have been seen in the swamp at night.
The baron is offering a bounty on giant spider pelts.
A hermit in the hills knows the location of a lost dwarven mine.
The old lighthouse keeper went mad after finding something in the caves below.
Drinking from the fountain in the town square grants good luck.
Orcs have been spotted massing in the foothills to the east.
The old bridge is actually built on a buried giant's bones.

tables.name: docks
tables.description: Tales told by sailors and dockworkers

entries.text: A ghost ship appears on foggy nights near the rocky shoals.
Smugglers use the sea caves for storing contraband.
A sea serpent destroyed a fishing boat last month.
The sunken temple offshore contains ancient treasure.
Merfolk trade with the fishermen at the hidden cove.
Pirates buried gold on the island across the bay.
The harbor master takes bribes to look the other way.
A kraken sleeps in the deep trench south of the harbor.
